Hey all May 26 qualified CA,

Congratulations on reaching this incredible milestone and taking the next step in your professional journey!

𝐈'𝐯𝐞 𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐚 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐩 𝐞𝐱𝐜𝐥𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐲 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐌𝐚𝐲 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔 𝐪𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐀𝐜𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐬—a space where we can connect, exchange ideas, seek guidance, and support one another as we begin our careers.

Let's collaborate, not compete.

If you'd like to join, feel free to comment below or send me a DM. I'll share the group link with you.
